Come hungry, stay a little longer.

Bar, restaurante and cafetería in San Miguel de Salinas. Proper breakfasts from nine, bocadillos and wraps through the afternoon, and a full kitchen of starters, pasta, grills, curries and pizza. The whole menu is in English y en español.
